summary: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026 disclosing that its board approved a new $500 million share repurchase program. Repurchases may occur in open-market transactions at prevailing prices or through privately negotiated deals, with timing and volume dependent on price, corporate and regulatory requirements, and market conditions; the program may be suspended or discontinued without notice. No price per share, premium, expiration, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. The authorization creates a buyback overhang, but execution pace and results remain discretionary; watch quarterly disclosure of shares retired and cash deployment.
